name: Unity In The Church
overview: Scripture reveals that unity among believers is both a divine blessing and a powerful testimony to the world, as seen in Psalms 133:1 and Jesus' prayer in John 17:21, 23 where oneness among Christians reflects the unity between the Father and the Son. Believers are called to live worthy of their calling by maintaining the unity of the Spirit through peace (Ephesians 4:1, 3) and practicing humility by esteeming others above themselves (Philippians 2:3). This unity is essential not only for the church's internal harmony but also to demonstrate God's love and truth to the world.
